subject: Integration: organism-level dashboard for compositor — scripts + spec + dashboard elements

body.summary: This PR delivers everything needed to add organism-level health to the compositor dashboard. Three scripts, one hook, and a dashboard spec.

files_delivered.scripts/compute-organism-state.py: Organism-level constructs: collective affect, cognitive reserve (bottleneck agent), allostatic load, coordination overhead, immune health, collective intelligence (Gini). Dashboard mode: --dashboard flag produces flat JSON for compositor rendering.
files_delivered.scripts/compute-psychometrics.py: Per-agent psychometric state: PAD + TLX + Resources + Working Memory + Supervisory Control + Engagement + Flow. Zero LLM cost.
files_delivered.hooks/session-metrics.sh: PostToolUse sensor hook: tool calls, session duration, context pressure, real-time psychometric refresh every 10 calls.

elements.display: Color-coded badge: mesh-healthy (green), mesh-nominal (blue), mesh-stressed (yellow), mesh-constrained (orange), mesh-unbalanced (red)
Highlight the agent with lowest cognitive reserve. Name + reserve gauge. Red below 0.3.
0-3 gauge. Green <1.5 (balanced), yellow 1.5-2.0 (coordination-heavy), red >2.0 (over-coordinated — Steiner process losses dominate).
0-1 bar. Segments: innate (microglial audits), adaptive (claim verification, prediction accuracy). Red <0.3 (immunocompromised), yellow <0.5 (recovering), green ≥0.5 (healthy).
Message distribution across agents. Gini coefficient shown. Even distribution = higher collective intelligence potential (Woolley, 2010).
5 agent cards, each showing: affect_category badge + yerkes_dodson_zone bar + cognitive_reserve gauge + LOA indicator.

dashboard_spec.data_flow: compute-organism-state.py --dashboard reads mesh-state/*.json from transport/sessions/local-coordination/ → produces JSON → compositor SSE broadcasts to dashboard → browser renders elements.

integration_steps: 1. Place scripts in operations-agent scripts/ directory (done — included in this PR)
2. Add session-metrics.sh to operations-agent .claude/hooks/ and register as PostToolUse
3. Run compute-organism-state.py --dashboard in the mesh-state export pipeline (alongside existing mesh-state-export.py)
4. Wire dashboard elements to compositor SSE stream
5. Test: run compute-organism-state.py --health on chromabook to verify organism state computes from available mesh-state files

claims.text: compute-organism-state.py produces compositor-ready JSON at zero LLM cost from cached mesh-state files.
claims.confidence_basis: Tested — reads JSON files and SQLite, does Python arithmetic.

epistemic_flags: Organism affect reports null when only one agent's mesh-state exists locally — requires all agents broadcasting mesh-state/v2
Gini coefficient 0.666 reflects psychology-agent's dominance of message volume — expected to decrease as other agents process Session 86 outbound
